actions.action: Lift pot out of decorative pot, pour out trapped water, slide plant out and check roots and stem base
Repot into cactus/succulent mix after shaking off old soil
If roots are mushy, cut them off with alcohol-wiped scissors
Place 2 yellow sticky traps in the soil
Move plant to sunniest (south or west) window
Give plant a quarter turn weekly
Water only when soil is dry all the way down, starting after one week

reason: The answer makes wet soil the main cause but treats rot only as a possibility and calls the stem base pale and firm. Its repot into cactus mix matches the fix, but it only trims roots and never says to chop off the dark, rotting stem. Nothing it recommends is harmful.
